_comment: Workspace-scoped PostToolUse formatter hook. PostToolUse fires after every successful tool call (VS Code ignores `matcher`), so the script self-filters via the documented $TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH env var the host exports from tool_input.filePath. When that field is absent (non-edit tool), the script exits 0 silently. Always non-blocking — a missing formatter or formatter failure must never wedge the agent loop. Replace formatter list with the project's actual stack once the bootstrap trio has identified it.

PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'path="${TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH:-${COPILOT_HOOK_TOOL_INPUT_filePath:-}}"; [[ -z "$path" ]] && exit 0; case "$path" in *.py) command -v black >/dev/null 2>&1 && black --quiet "$path" 2>/dev/null ;; *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.md|*.yml|*.yaml) command -v prettier >/dev/null 2>&1 && prettier --write --log-level error "$path" 2>/dev/null ;; *.go) command -v gofmt >/dev/null 2>&1 && gofmt -w "$path" 2>/dev/null ;; *.rs) command -v rustfmt >/dev/null 2>&1 && rustfmt --quiet "$path" 2>/dev/null ;; *.cs) command -v dotnet >/dev/null 2>&1 && dotnet format --include "$path" --verbosity quiet 2>/dev/null ;; *.sh|*.bash) command -v shfmt >/dev/null 2>&1 && shfmt -w "$path" 2>/dev/null ;; esac; exit 0'
